info.title: APICore
info.description:
API with JWT Authentication — synced with ServicesNew codebase.

Support: 09337243322

**Auth flow:** `POST /api/userPassBase64` → `POST /api/Login` → use `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on `/api/WebService/*`.

**IP whitelist:** Non-demo tokens are validated against the client's IP (`valid_ip` / `valid_ip2`).

**Currency:** Monetary fields are returned in the site currency (`currency` field). Amounts are `number` (may include decimals).

post.summary: Search flights for a specific date
post.description:
Returns priced flights for the selected day.

**New/important response fields:**
- `currency` — site currency of price fields
- `airline_logo` / `airline_logo_url`
- `bag`, `duration_minutes`
- `end_date_flight` / `end_time_flight` — calculated arrival (null if stop or unknown duration)
- `cancellation_rule` — parsed penalty rules
- `nationalities.allowed` / `nationalities.disallowed` — FA/EN/AR name lists
- `other_flights` — alternatives in the same group

Date must be today or later (`-203` otherwise).

IATA_airport.description: IATA code used in from_flight / to_flight

AvailInfo.title: AvailInfo
AvailInfo.description: Origin, destination and flight date. IKA is normalized to THR server-side.

date_flight.description: yyyy-MM-dd; must be today or later

Avail15DaysInfo.title: Avail15DaysInfo
Avail15DaysInfo.description: Best price calendar for a 15-day window

price.description: Lowest price for that day in site currency; null if no flight

NationalityNamesByLang.description: Nationality display names per language. Empty array means no list for that locale.

FlightNationalities.description: Allowed / disallowed passenger nationalities for this flight (localized lists).

OtherFlightItem.description: Alternative same-route options aggregated under the selected flight

ajency_online_ID.description: Agency id — required later in GetCaptcha

price_final.description: Adult final price (site currency). 0 when capacity is 0

capacity.description: Available seats (may be sum of other_flights capacities)

carrier.description: Aircraft family: Boeing MD / Airbus / Fokker / unknown

airline_logo_url.description: Full CDN URL for airline logo

cabinclass.description: RBD / class code — pass to GetCaptcha

price_Markup.description: Configured site markup for display (percent as-is if <100, otherwise absolute amount in site currency). 0 for system flights / no markup.

has_stop.description: Non-zero means connecting/stop flight. When set, end_date_flight / end_time_flight are null.

duration_minutes.description: Flight duration in minutes; null if unknown

end_date_flight.description: Arrival date calculated from departure + duration_minutes. Null when duration unknown or has_stop != 0.

end_time_flight.description: Arrival time (HH:mm). Null when duration unknown or has_stop != 0.

cancellation_rule.description: Parsed cancellation penalty rules for site language. Null/empty when unavailable.

other_flights.description: Other matching options for the same airline/route/number group

CaptchaInfo.title: CaptchaInfo
CaptchaInfo.description: Select a flight from Available and start reservation (step 1)

id_request.description: Reservation request id for next steps

link_captcha.description: Captcha image URL. Empty string when user.captcha_status != 1

messages.description: Path-alert / route notice in site language (HTML stripped). Null when none.

Passenger_Info.title: Passenger_Info
Passenger_Info.description: Passenger for Reservation. Max 9 passengers. INF requires at least as many ADL. Duplicate names/codes rejected.

passengerType.description: ADL >=12y, CHD 2-11y, INF <2y (validated when birthday is sent)

nationality.description: 1 = Iranian, 2 = Non-Iranian. Also inferred from nationalitycode IRN/IRI -> Iranian.

passengerCode.description: Iranian national code for domestic Iranian passengers; passport number otherwise

nationalitycode.description: ISO-like nationality code. IRI/IRN = Iran. Examples: PAK, KSA, IRQ, AFG, ARM, BHR, CHN, IND, KWT, MYS, SYR, TUR, TKM, TJK, QAT. For flight-level acceptance check Available.nationalities.allowed / disallowed.

expdate.description: Passport expiry. When provided must be at least 6 months after flight date.

birthday.description: Birth date. When provided, age is validated against passengerType relative to flight date.

ReservationInfo.title: ReservationInfo
ReservationInfo.description: Temporary reservation (step 2). email is optional. captchcode is required only when the authenticated user has captcha_status=1.

captchcode.description: Required only if user.captcha_status=1. Read digits from link_captcha image.

countryMobileCode.description: e.g. +98 or 0098. For +98/+964 mobile must be 11 digits.

fareprice.description: May be omitted for some agencies (e.g. ajency_online_ID=446)

PayAndBuyTicketInfo.title: PayAndBuyTicketInfo
PayAndBuyTicketInfo.description: Create payment link. accept_price in response is the payable amount in IRR (reserve.total_price).

CheckTransactionInfo.title: CheckTransactionInfo
CheckTransactionInfo.description: Verify bank payment after PayAndBuyTicket redirect

CheckPenaltiInfo.title: CheckPenaltiInfo
CheckPenaltiInfo.description: Get cancel penalty for a reserved factor

CancelTicketInfo.title: CancelTicketInfo
CancelTicketInfo.description: Cancel one or more tickets of a reserved factor

penalti.description: Penalty value (required integer; demo users max 100)

listticketID.description: Ticket numbers belonging to this reserve

back_cart.description: If true, refund to card (etebar_add=2); otherwise credit (etebar_add=1)
